title: Photos libraries
whyItMatters: A Photos library can hold years of personal photographs and videos. Its size and location show how much visual history stays on the Mac.
source: Apple Support: Photos Library is stored by default in the Pictures folder - https://support.apple.com/guide/photos/photo-library-overview-pht211de786/mac
notes: Recurses for size and count by metadata only (a folder's own size is near zero); large libraries hit the 20000 cap and are marked truncated. Files are never opened. Libraries moved off ~/Pictures are not matched.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Photos choose File > Export > Export Unmodified Originals for the items you keep, then copy them off this Mac.
cleanup.signOut: Turn off iCloud Photos in System Settings > Apple Account > iCloud before removing any local copy.
steps: Open Photos and check that every photo you need is exported or safe in iCloud.
Quit Photos so the library is no longer in use.
Delete the library folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Photos held only in this library are gone for good; anything in iCloud Photos stays in the account.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Export photos, videos, slideshows, and memories on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/photos/export-photos-videos-slideshows-and-memories-pht6e157c5f/mac
